svg.title: SBMS code history
svg.desc: Mainline source-code changes, 2026-06-27 to 2026-11-19. Each commit adds green upward candles then red downward candles. Linear cumulative net lines; equal spacing per commit. Excludes vendor code, non-code files, this chart generator and chart-only commits. Snapshot b4093e316603ba954bf01a8da8005f3c694ea4fb.
